about: Hand-labelled ball positions for the three demo clips in the repo root.
candidates-<clip>.json lists, for frames sampled at <fps>, the top 6 YOLO11n ball candidates (score >= 0.03) with normalised centres.
labels[k] refers to frame k of that file: a number n = candidate n is the real ball; -1 = every candidate is a false detection;
"none" = no candidate at all (skipped: the ball may be hidden or undetected); "?" = could not tell (skipped).
{x, y} = the real ball is here although the YOLO11n model had no candidate (found by the football ball model, checked by eye).
Labelled by eye from 3x enlarged crops of each candidate (2026-11-17).

events.about: Shots and goals seen on the video (2026-11-18). A detected event counts when its time falls inside [from, to] seconds. "maybe" events are not scored either way.

d1.note: ball played toward goal, collected by the keeper

d3.note: attack on the right-hand goal at the end of the clip
